verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a bulk-operation capability, such as multi-select edit or delete, batch endpoints, or bulk actions on triggers, SLOs, boards, or markers. The REST API, OpenAPI spec, Honeymarker CRUD CLI, and MCP tools are developer building blocks for scripting per-item operations, so they earn no credit. Queries that aggregate across many events are analysis, not bulk management of items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
